description: Monitor and scrape Discord trade signal channels, aggregate market news, manage data feeds, and fire alerts on volume spikes and indicator conditions.
frequency: every 15 minutes (Discord scrape) + daily (YouTube scrape) + event-driven (volume spikes)

workflows.name: scrape-discord
workflows.description: Monitor Discord trade channels every 15 minutes for new trade tips and signals
steps: Connect to Discord API
Fetch new messages from monitored channels since last check
Parse messages for trade signals (ticker, direction, entry, TP, SL)
Filter out noise (non-trade messages)
Structure signals as JSON: {ticker, direction, entry, tp, sl, source, timestamp}
Write signals to daily log file
If signal meets quality threshold: flag for morning brief / alert Greg via Telegram
workflows.output: Structured trade signal records in memory + Telegram notification for high-quality signals
workflows.approval_gate: None — autonomous. Greg reviews signals each morning.
workflows.blast_radius: Low — read-only from Discord, write to local memory only

workflows.name: scrape-youtube
workflows.description: Daily YouTube scrape for trading strategy content and market insights
steps: Query YouTube API for new videos from tracked trading channels
Download transcripts / descriptions for new videos
Summarize key insights (strategy ideas, risk tips, market analysis)
Store summaries in memory with tags
Include top 2-3 insights in morning brief
workflows.output: Summarized video insights stored in memory, surfaced in morning brief

workflows.name: monitor-feeds
workflows.description: Watch volume spikes and indicator alerts; trigger downstream workflows
steps: Poll configured data feeds for volume anomalies
Check defined indicator conditions (e.g., RSI threshold, volume spike %)
If threshold crossed: log event with context
If significant: send Telegram alert to Greg with ticker + context
Optionally: queue a chart generation task for the triggered ticker
workflows.approval_gate: Alert only — Greg decides whether to act
workflows.blast_radius: Low — notification only, no trade execution

workflows.name: morning-brief
workflows.description: Daily morning summary of market, portfolio, signals, and news
steps: Fetch overnight Discord signals (top quality signals flagged)
Pull Hyper Liquid portfolio overview (positions, P&L, margin)
Get overall market volume and key metrics
Gather overnight news digest (crypto/markets)
Compile YouTube insights from last 24h
Generate daily letter: market overview + portfolio status + top signals + action items
Send via Telegram to Greg
workflows.blast_radius: Low — read-only data, message to Greg only
